Demand Curves & Revenue Optimization

The revenue-maximizing sweet spot is at 72-76% occupancy. Pushing for higher occupancy (90%) requires significant price cuts that reduce total revenue. The optimal balance is around 75% occupancy.

Why This Strategy Wins

1. Highest net revenue - AED 3.37M beats both pure long-term (AED 3.36M) and pure holiday home (AED 3.12M)
2. Diversified income - 75% stable long-term + 25% variable short-term reduces risk
3. Manageable complexity - Only 10 units need holiday home management vs 56 in all-HH strategy
4. Summer protection - 46 long-term units provide steady income during May-Aug low season
5. Lower costs - AED 906K vs AED 2.95M for all holiday homes; costs are only 21% of gross
6. Upside optionality - Can convert more units to holiday homes during peak if demand justifies
